Added value-distribution histogram to t393_census.zig and a synthetic Z-cell positive control. t393_score_bound_retraction.summary: The paragraph at two-life-census-2026-08-06.md:162 argued that a Benson-alive chain's k stones bound the score away from zero (≥k for Black), which would rule out straddling for terminated lines. This is false and refuted by T393's own 3×3 table: 90 Black-alive entries have value ≤ 0, with the lowest at L=H=-2 (two-stone chain). The doc now carries an explicit withdrawal with the value-distribution table and corrected reasoning.
t393_score_bound_retraction.witness: Black alive, L=H=-2, position colex at 3×3: ooo / o.x / ox. (two single-stone Black chains, each Benson-alive, White holding the rest)

t393_control_gap.summary: The three seeded mutants (never-alive, always-alive, White-blind) test the Benson-alive predicate on hand-built canary boards, never in the sweep. No control proved the Z cell can report non-zero.
t393_control_gap.fix: Added synthetic Z-cell positive control (selftest block 7): a 2×2 fixture with colex 24 (two Black diagonal stones, both Benson-alive) and a straddling entry (L=-1, H=1). The sweep reports z_either==1, proving the Z cell reporting path is live. All 3 new control checks pass.
t393_control_gap.lesson: A control that exercises a predicate is not a control on the cell you report.

t394_certification_vs_confinement.summary: force-life-classifier-2026-08-06.md:176-180 concluded that T2's 1.05% exception rate bounds the 'stop valuing, it's a draw' oracle error. This bounds the wrong direction: T2 measures draw-by-loop ⟹ neither-can-force; the oracle needs the converse (neither-can-force ⟹ draw), and T3 measures that as 85.3% false at 4×4. The doc now carries an explicit withdrawal stating confinement is not certification.
t394_certification_vs_confinement.T2_actual: draws-by-loop are CONFINED to the neither-can-force class (0 exceptions through 3×3; 32 at 4×3; 9,376 at 4×4 of 895,216)
t394_certification_vs_confinement.T3_actual: neither-can-force class at 4×4 is 85.3% decisive (19,518,338 of 22,885,430)
t394_certification_vs_confinement.verdict: confinement ≠ certification; T2→T3 pointer added so the two cannot be read apart
